giver: Elder Maren and the people of Reece
feel: A warm, unhurried first hour: meet Reece, learn the pack's tools, hear the first worry.

quests.title: Welcome to Reece
quests.summary: Elder Maren meets you at Reece's well, gives you the Field Guide (a Patchouli book) and asks you to look around before night falls.

quests.title: Read the Field Guide
quests.summary: Open the Field Guide and find the page on the quiet forest; a pressed leaf between the pages hints that the guide was written by someone who left Reece in a hurry.

quests.title: Old Streets, New Roofs
quests.summary: Reece is a ChoiceTheorem overhauled village: find its smithy, its farms, its chapel and its market square, and greet one villager in each.

quests.title: Every Hand Learns
quests.summary: Elder Maren explains that Reece trains its people in skills: open the Pufferfish skill screen, earn your first point in any tree and spend it.

quests.title: A Bitter Tonic
quests.summary: The cleric brews skill tonics for those who want to unlearn a choice: learn how Friends of the Forest Skills resets work, and keep one tonic in reserve.

quests.title: Timber!
quests.summary: Hold the Ultimine key and fell a whole tree in one swing, then gather 64 logs for the village woodpile.

quests.title: The Stone That Remembers
quests.summary: Attune to the waystone in Reece's square, then find a second waystone out in the wild and warp home with it.
quests.reward: A return scroll, 2 warp stones' worth of shards

quests.title: Room to Carry
quests.summary: Reece's leatherworker shows you how to stitch a Sophisticated Backpack; craft one and fit it with a pickup upgrade.

quests.title: The Hourglass Night
quests.summary: Craft a bed and sleep through your first night; with Hourglass the stars wheel by faster the more of the server is asleep.

quests.title: Under the Open Sky
quests.summary: Make a Comforts sleeping bag for nights on the road and a hammock for afternoon naps, then sleep in the bag at least 200 blocks from Reece.

quests.title: The Sexton's Promise
quests.summary: Old Edda keeps the graveyard: if you fall, a gravestone holds your things where you died, and only you can open it. She gives you an obituary book from the last adventurer who didn't come back.

quests.title: Dressed for Reece
quests.summary: The tailor fusses that armour is ugly at the harvest dance: learn the cosmetic armour slots, then bring her 8 wool to make you a festival look.

quests.title: Which Way the Wind Blows
quests.summary: Craft a Nature's Compass and use it to find a biome you have never seen.

quests.title: Which Way the Stones Lie
quests.summary: Craft an Explorer's Compass and follow it to the nearest well; the compass learns more places as your story goes on.

quests.title: Hands of the Field
quests.summary: Meet four organisations: the Growers' co-operative (farmer), the Anglers' society (fisherman), the Herbalists (cleric) and the Tavern keepers (butcher). Each has work when you're ready.
quests.reward: Seeds, a fishing rod, a herb pouch, a meal

quests.title: Hands of the Forge
quests.summary: Meet the Miners' guild (toolsmith), the Crafters' guild (mason), the Bounty office (weaponsmith, at the Bountiful board) and the Hunters' lodge (fletcher).
quests.reward: Torches, a stonecutter, a bounty contract, arrows

quests.title: Hands of the Road
quests.summary: Meet the Couriers (cartographer), the Village watch (a Guard Villagers guard), the Arcane order (librarian) and the Sanctuary keepers (shepherd).
quests.reward: A blank map, a shield, a book, a lead

quests.title: The Cleric's Worry
quests.summary: Sister Wren, Reece's cleric, confides that the forest has gone silent: no fireflies, no birdsong at dusk, and the old spirits no longer answer her prayers. She asks for your help.
quests.reward: A healing potion, the main story opens
